force_mc.console.title: Force
force_mc.settings.title: Force settings
force_mc.settings.list: Session list on the game screen
force_mc.settings.terminalOpacity.toolti: How solid the background of Force's view is: 0% shows the game through it, 100% hides it.
force_mc.settings.terminalPadding.toolti: Space between the screen's edge and Force's view, in GUI pixels.
force_mc.settings.blur.tooltip: Blur the game behind Force's view, so the text stays easy to read.
force_mc.settings.textScale.tooltip: Text size of Force's view and the session list, on top of Minecraft's GUI scale.
force_mc.settings.sidebarOpacity.tooltip: How solid the session list's background is: 0% leaves only the text.
force_mc.settings.sidebarPosition.toolti: Where the session list sits on the game screen.
force_mc.settings.hudRows.tooltip: The most sessions the list shows at once.
force_mc.settings.hud.tooltip: Show the session list when the game starts (the key binding shows and hides it any time).
force_mc.settings.toasts.tooltip: A toast when a session needs you or finishes.
force_mc.settings.keys.open.tooltip: Controls → Key Binds, where Force's keys are (under Force). A key can be a combination: hold Ctrl, Alt or Shift while pressing it.
